question: Identify all roles that are compliant and list the resources they grant access to, including the type of each resource.

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(:Resource{type:''Database''}), (p:Policy)-[:Enforces]->(r) GROUP BY r.name RETURN r.name AS roleName, COUNT(DISTINCT p)')

question: Find all policies that enforce roles which grant access to resources of type 'Application' and have a review status of 'Pending'. List the policy names and the corresponding resource names.
sql: SELECT graph.policy_name, graph.resource_name FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: ''Pending''})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: ''Application''}) RETURN p.name AS policy_name, res.name AS resource_name') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(policy_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', resource_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (p:Policy {review_status: ''Pending''})-[:Enforces]->(r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource {type: ''Application''}) RETURN p.name AS policy_name, res.name AS resource_name')

question: Identify users who have attempted access events from more than three distinct IP addresses and show their user ID along with the count of distinct IPs.
sql: SELECT graph.UserID, graph.COUNTDISTINCT FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) GROUP BY u.User_id RETURN u.User_id AS UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.ip_address)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(UserID INT PATH '$[0]', COUNTDISTINCT INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph

question: For each group, calculate the average number of resources accessed per user within that group. Only include groups where users have attempted access events. Return the group name and the calculated average.
sql: SELECT graph.group_name, graph.avg_resources_accessed_per_user FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) GROUP BY g.name RETURN g.name AS group_name, avg(COUNT(DISTINCT r)) AS avg_resources_accessed_per_user') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(group_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', avg_resources_accessed_per_user INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) GROUP BY g.name RETURN g.name AS group_name, avg(COUNT(DISTINCT r)) AS avg_resources_accessed_per_user')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (g:Group)<-[:BelongsTo]-(u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) GROUP BY g.name RETURN g.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u.department)')

question: Determine the average number of access events per user for users who have attempted access to resources governed by policies with a review status of 'Approved'. Only consider users from the 'IT' department.
sql: SELECT graph.AverageAccessEventsPerUser FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (u:User{department:''IT''})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(p:Policy{review_status:''Approved''}) RETURN AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae)) AS AverageAccessEventsPerUser') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(AverageAccessEventsPerUser INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (u:User{department:''IT''})-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource)<-[:GrantsAccessTo]-(p:Policy{review_status:''Approved''}) RETURN AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ae)) AS AverageAccessEventsPerUser')

question: List all roles that are compliant (is_compliant = true) and have been enforced by policies that were effective in the year 2023. Include the role name and the policy name.

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (u:User)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent) WHERE u.status = ''Active'' GROUP BY u.department RETURN u.department, COUNT(u) AS user_count')

question: Find the latest login time for users who have accessed at least one resource of type 'Database'.

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource), (r2:Resource) GROUP BY r.type RETURN r.type, AVG(access_count)')

question: Find users who belong to more than one group and have attempted access to resources located in the 'API Endpoint' type, displaying their names and the count of distinct API endpoints they've tried to access.

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (u:User)-[:BelongsTo]->(g:Group), (u)-[:AttemptsAccess]->(ae:AccessEvent)-[:Targets]->(r:Resource) WHERE r.type = ''API Endpoint'' GROUP BY u.name RETURN u.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r) AS api_endpoints_accessed')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('information_technology_identity_and_access_management', 'MATCH (r:Role)-[:GrantsAccessTo]->(res:Resource) WHERE r.is_compliant = false AND res.type = ''API Endpoint'' GROUP BY r.name RETURN r.name, COUNT(res) AS api_endpoint_count ORDER BY api_endpoint_count DESC LIMIT 3')
